ns2:section.sectionText: Organized as a survey, this course seeks to provide a basic introduction to some of the major currents and practitioners in European and American photography from the mid-19th century to the present day. A number of key historical texts that reflect photography's unstable status between technology and aesthetics, and mass culture and the avant-garde will also be examined. The course's key narrative will emphasize the various ways in which photography (in both its analog and digital forms) operates in a space somewhere between art and document. Although discussion begins in the 19th century, emphasis will be placed on 20th and 21st photographic practice.
